notes.drawing: A closed booklet with the globe emblem and one line of lettering. The cover is the upright rounded rectangle Phosphor's file and book stand in (x 48 to 208, y 32 to 224, corner radius 8); no Phosphor icon is exactly that rectangle, so there is no frame check. The globe is a circle of radius 40 with an equator and one straight meridian: globe-simple's ellipse, made this small, closes up at 16 and 20 px.
notes.bold: The globe grows from radius 40 to 44 and sits 4 units lower, and the line below is shorter and 6 units lower. At radius 40 the four openings of the globe were only 16 units wide and filled in at 16 px.
